title: Target Panic
description: Rapid-target clicking — hit as many targets as you can before time runs out.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start a timed round.
2. Click targets that appear on screen to score points.
3. Targets spawn faster as you score.
4. Aim for a high score before time runs out.

Tips:
- Keep your cursor near the center to minimize travel.
- Prioritize visible larger targets first.
